trainers.instruction: This is a map of East Africa. Select the waterfall to learn more.

atoms.b: Victoria Falls is a massive ((++waterfall mountain)) on the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe. It acts as the boundary between the upper and middle Zambezi, the largest river in this region.
atoms.sound: Victoria Falls is a massive waterfall on the border between Zambia and Zimbaarbwe. It acts as the boundary between the upper and middle Zambezi , the largest river in this region.

atoms.b: The falling water is so ((++powerful weak)) that the spray rises over 400 metres into the air and can be seen from almost 50 kilometres away.
The waterfall can be viewed from Victoria Falls Bridge, a railway bridge connecting Zambia and Zimbabwe, which was the ((++highest lowest)) bridge in the world when it opened in 1905.

instruction.text: Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: Mount Kilimanjaro is a dormant volcano located in Tanzania. At 5,895 metres high, it is the tallest mountain in Africa.
At Mount Kilimanjaro’s summit, freezing temperatures as low as -18 °C are common.
Mount Kilimanjaro is a popular trek with tourists as you can climb it without using any technical equipment.
The white-necked raven can be found up the mountain, often attempting to steal food from climbers.

hint.label: Archipelago
hint.text: An archipelago is a group or chain of islands.

atoms.b: The Seychelles is an archipelago of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean. It is a popular tourist destination because of its ((++warm cold)) weather and sandy beaches.
Only 8 of these islands are inhabited permanently. In fact, 90% of the country’s ((++population economy)) live on the island of Mahé.
atoms.sound: Only eight of these islands are inhabited permanently. In fact, 90% of the country’s population live on the island of marhey.

atoms.b: The Seychelles is home to many important coral reefs, which ((++protect damage)) the coastlines of the islands and provide habitats for fish. However, rising sea temperatures are a big threat to their health.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Madagascar is the fourth-largest island in the world and is found in the Indian Ocean. Notably, almost 90% of its wildlife is endemic, meaning that it lives nowhere else in the world.
atoms.sound: Madagascur is the fourth-largest island in the world and is found in the Indian Ocean. Notably, almost 90% of its wildlife is endemic, meaning that it lives nowhere else in the world.

atoms.text: One of the most famous examples of this are lemurs, which can be found in the island’s forests and rainforests. The ring-tailed lemur is a sociable species that eats fruit and leaves and is active during the day.
atoms.sound: One of the most famous examples of this are lemurs, which can be found in the island’s forests and rain forests. The ring-tailed lemur is a sociable species that eats fruit and leaves and is active during the day.

atoms.text: Another famous species of lemur, called the aye-aye, behaves completely differently. It is a solitary animal that is active at night and mainly eats bugs that it scoops out from holes in trees with its extra-long finger.
